steps.name: Perform Script
contextEffects: Runs in the same session and therefore shares the caller's FMSE context and variables according to normal script scoping.
steps.dialogBehavior: FMSE has no interactive user. Dialog-dependent options must be Off or are ignored/unsupported.
risks: Local variables in the caller are not a substitute for an explicit subscript parameter contract.

steps.name: Perform Script on Server

options.effect: Caller waits and can receive script result and server-side error.
Asynchronous; no dependable result handoff to the initiating script.

contextEffects: Creates a separate FMSE session; it does not inherit client layout, found set, sort order, current record, variables, or global-field values.
steps.dialogBehavior: FMSE has no interactive user. Dialog-dependent options must be Off or are ignored/unsupported.
risks: Requires explicit JSON parameter/context reconstruction.
Nested PSOS creates another independent session.
Design for idempotency, record locking, path collisions, queueing, and concurrent execution.
